title: PR #2322: feat: allow clients to write artifacts via SendMessageRequest (#1995)
content:
## Summary

Lets a client write artifacts (including multiple artifacts in one call, or chunked updates) over both live streams and unary/server-streaming calls, split out of #2153 so the live channel can be reviewed on its own.

Because `StreamRequest` in #2153 embeds `SendMessageRequest`, extending `SendMessageRequest` once enables client-written artifacts across `SendMessage`, `SendStreamingMessage`, and `SendLiveMessage` alike.

## What's here

1. **`SendMessageRequest.artifact_updates` (`repeated TaskArtifactUpdateEvent`)** — lets a client send work-item artifacts alongside a control `message` (for example `"please translate this doc"` + the doc when creating a task) or on their own when continuing an existing task (`task_id` set).
   - `message` is required when creating a task (when no `task_id` is provided, as the agent needs a control message to know what to do with the artifacts); it may be omitted only when sending `artifact_updates` to an existing task.
   - When `message` and `artifact_updates` are sent together and a `Task` is created/updated, `message` is appended to `timeline` first, followed by `artifact_updates` in list order. If the agent responds with a direct `Message` without creating a `Task`, neither is persisted in a task.

2. **`AgentCapabilities.user_artifacts` (`optional bool`)** — indicates whether the agent accepts client-written (`ROLE_USER`) artifacts in `SendMessageRequest.artifact_updates` (otherwise `UnsupportedOperationError` / `StreamError`).

3. **`generation` ownership** — on each client-sent `TaskArtifactUpdateEvent`, `generation` is server-owned: clients MUST leave it unset, servers MUST ignore any value received, and the server stamps the authoritative value when broadcasting the resulting `TaskArtifactUpdateEvent` downstream.

4. **`Artifact.role`** — restored so a client-written artifact (`ROLE_USER`) stays distinguishable from an agent output (`ROLE_AGENT`, the default). Deferred out of the history ADR (#2129) for this change.

## Verification

`buf breaking` (FILE) clean, api-linter `problems: []`, protolint clean, markdownlint clean.

Related: #1995, #2153
